tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Marketing pages alternate surface and surface-alt section by section, never two of the same in a row.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating marketing tiles, sidebars, the app canvas behind cards.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, popovers on surface-alt.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rules, input borders (1px).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines on every surface. Also the logo colour on light grounds.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, captions, on surface or surface-alt.

tokens.name: hong
tokens.usage: Brand red accent. Highlights one word in a headline, the active tab, the grading-ready badge. Never a button fill, an error or the logo.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Every primary button, link and focus ring. The only colour that means 'tap me'.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an action fill.

tokens.name: action-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, info banners, secondary button fill; ink text on it.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Paid, present, passed. Always with a word or tick, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Payment retrying, licence expiring, trial ending.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed payment, cancelled mandate, destructive confirm. Always paired with an icon and words so it never reads as brand red.

tokens.name: belt-white
tokens.usage: Rank chip for white belt. Outlined with line, ink text.

tokens.name: belt-yellow
tokens.usage: Rank chip for yellow belt and tags. Ink text.

tokens.name: belt-green
tokens.usage: Rank chip for green belt and tags. White text.

tokens.name: belt-blue
tokens.usage: Rank chip for blue belt and tags. White text.

tokens.name: belt-red
tokens.usage: Rank chip for red belt and tags. White text.

tokens.name: belt-black
tokens.usage: Rank chip for poom and dan grades. White text, gold dan stripes drawn as belt-yellow bars.

families.sans: "Inter", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, gutters, phone side margins.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, between cards.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between a headline and the content under it.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Marketing section padding, top and bottom. The whitespace is the design.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, rank chips, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List groups, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and marketing tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The app icon tile, hero device frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button and segmented control.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Raised cards on surface-alt in light mode only. Dark mode uses surface-raised with no shadow.
